title: Sean Payton announces that QB Bo Nix is expected back in two weeks for their minicamp practices

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sean Payton announces that QB Bo Nix is expected back in two weeks for their minicamp practices
sources.description: The Denver Broncos began their first set of OTA practices this week, and today was their first practice session open to the media. As expected, starting quarterback Bo Nix did not participate after undergoing surgery on his broken ankle that he suffered during the Broncos’ Divisional Round victory over the Buffalo Bills.
